about_the_game:
Flesh, money, and chrome. Welcome to the underworld of cybernetic enhancement.

This game is not like any other retail sim. In Ripperdoc Simulator, you are the surgeon of the shadows — a black-market specialist who installs cybernetic body mods in the darkest corners of a sprawling cyberpunk megalopolis. By day, you run a dingy electronics shop in a crime-ridden district, trading in junk tech and refurbished gear. By night, you perform illegal implantations on desperate clients seeking power, beauty, or survival — no matter the cost.

Features:

Run Your Clinic from the Shadows
Disguise your operation behind a cluttered tech store. Sell modded devices, source rare components, and keep the authorities off your trail.

Perform Gruesome Procedures
Extract eyes, amputate limbs, and replace flesh with chrome in fully interactive, gore-drenched surgeries. Every implant has a purpose — and a price.

Meet the City’s Desperate and Dangerous
From street thugs to corpo defectors, clients will come to you with their own stories, demands, and risks. Will you enhance them… or exploit them?

Upgrade Your Setup
Improve your tools, expand your hidden operating theater, and acquire illicit software to unlock new procedures and modifications.

Live the Cyberpunk Grind
Balance the life of a shady ripperdoc with the gritty economy of the slums. Buy low, sell high, and trade favors with gangs, fixers, and black-market vendors.

Enter a World of Flesh and Steel

Inspired by classic cyberpunk, body horror, and dark dystopian futures, Ripperdoc Simulator throws you into the pulsing veins of a broken society — where salvation is sold by the inch, and your scalpel is the key to survival.
